commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-cyrus-imap
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-cyrus-imap
<iptables> -X f2b-cyrus-imap

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-cyrus-imap
done; done

printf %b "Hi,\n
The jail cyrus-imap has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban"|mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] cyrus-imap: started on <fq-hostname>" root@localhost

printf %b "Hi,\n
The jail cyrus-imap has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban"|mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] cyrus-imap: stopped on <fq-hostname>" root@localhost

printf %b "Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against cyrus-imap.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban"|mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] cyrus-imap: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>" root@localhost

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
usedns = no
banaction = iptables-allports
mta = mail
[cyrus-imap]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
maxretry = x
findtime = 10m
action = %(action_mw)s
